source.compiler: Whiteulver's database of the game's teams, xflea's spreadsheet of it (v1.1, December 2018), as keyser1884's SWOS-MCP holds it (swos_database.db, commit ac15d74, 9 July 2025)
source.provenance: Row for row the spreadsheet; its Swedish club records equal the game's own team file (304 of 304 players), and its national squads gazchap's database (64 of 64 checked). A SWOS United thread (2021) says some minor nations' squads and nationalities in the game predate 1996.
